<mxCell id="title" value="Problem 3: Docker Compose stack as delivered (before fix)" style="text;html=1;fontSize=18;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="30" y="10" width="700" height="30" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="host" value="Docker host: docker compose, default bridge network (service names resolved by Docker DNS)" style="rounded=1;arcSize=2;dashed=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#333333;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;fontStyle=1;html=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="200" y="50" width="1030" height="490" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="user" value="User / client" style="shape=umlActor;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;html=1;outlineConnect=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="45" y="210" width="40" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="deps" value="<b>docker-compose.yml</b>: depends_on nginx → api → postgres, redis (start order only)<br>no healthchecks, no restart policy, password hard-coded" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#999999;dashed=1;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="260" y="90" width="520" height="44" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="nginx" value="<b>nginx</b> (nginx:1.25)<br>listen 80<br>location = / → 200 "Welcome"<br>location /api/ → proxy_pass api:3001" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="260" y="190" width="210" height="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="api" value="<b>api</b> (build ./api, node:20-alpine)<br>express, listens on :3000<br>GET /api/users, GET /status<br>pg Pool + ioredis" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="620" y="190" width="220" height="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="postgres" value="<b>postgres</b> (postgres:15)<br>:5432, not published<br>max_connections = 100 (default)<br>no volume" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="990" y="110" width="210" height="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="redis" value="<b>redis</b> (redis:7)<br>:6379, not published<br>key: last_call" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="990" y="300" width="210" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="confd" value="./nginx/conf.d → /etc/nginx/conf.d<br>(mounted: default.conf)" style="shape=note;size=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="260" y="360" width="210" height="46" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="nginxconf" value="./nginx/nginx.conf<br>empty file, not mounted" style="shape=note;size=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#999999;dashed=1;fontColor=#777777;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="260" y="440" width="210" height="46" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="initsql" value="./postgres/init.sql<br>ALTER SYSTEM SET max_connections = 20<br>not mounted, never runs" style="shape=note;size=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#999999;dashed=1;fontColor=#777777;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="970" y="430" width="250" height="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e-user-nginx" value="HTTP localhost:8080<br>(ports 8080:80)" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=block;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" edge="1" parent="1" source="user" target="nginx"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e-nginx-api" value="proxy_pass http://api:3001<br><b>nothing listens on :3001 → 502</b>" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=cross;endFill=0;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#b85450;dashed=1;fontColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#f5f5f5;" edge="1" parent="1" source="nginx" target="api"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>

<mxCell id="legend-title" value="Issues (numbers match SOLUTION.md)" style="text;html=1;fontStyle=1;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontColor=#b85450;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="200" y="555" width="400" height="24" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legend-left" value="<b>1</b> nginx proxies to :3001, the API listens on :3000: every /api/ call returns 502.<br><b>2</b> No pool.on('error'): a Postgres restart crashes the API process.<br><b>3</b> No restart policy: a crashed container stays down.<br><b>4</b> nginx resolves "api" once at startup: a recreated API (new IP) gets 502s." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;spacingTop=2;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="200" y="582" width="510" height="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legend-right" value="<b>5</b> ioredis queues and retries while Redis is down: requests hang over 90 s.<br><b>6</b> release() skipped on query error, no pool timeout: leaked clients exhaust the pool.<br><b>7</b> depends_on waits for container start only, no health checks.<br><b>8</b> init.sql and nginx.conf are never mounted: dead, misleading config." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=12;spacingTop=2;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="720" y="582" width="510" height="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
1 nginx proxies to :3001, the API listens on :3000: every /api/ call returns 502.
2 No pool.on('error'): a Postgres restart crashes the API process.
3 No restart policy: a crashed container stays down.
4 nginx resolves "api" once at startup: a recreated API (new IP) gets 502s.

text.tspan: 1 nginx proxies to :3001, the API listens on :3000: every /api/ call returns 502.
2 No pool.on('error'): a Postgres restart crashes the API process.
3 No restart policy: a crashed container stays down.
4 nginx resolves "api" once at startup: a recreated API (new IP) gets 502s.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 508px; height: 1px; padding-top: 591px; margin-left: 702px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
5 ioredis queues and retries while Redis is down: requests hang over 90 s.
6 release() skipped on query error, no pool timeout: leaked clients exhaust the pool.
7 depends_on waits for container start only, no health checks.
8 init.sql and nginx.conf are never mounted: dead, misleading config.

7 depends_on waits for container start only, no health checks.
8 init.sql and nginx.conf are never mounted: dead, misleading config.
